jobs.title: Creative Fashion Manager
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY : We are seeking an experienced and visionary Creative Fashion Manager to lead the end-to-end product development process while overseeing three core functions: Fashion Brand, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room. This role is reporting to COO and responsible for driving seasonal product strategies, ensuring design excellence, managing cross-functional execution, and delivering commercially successful collections that align with the company's brand identity and business objectives. JOB DESCRIPTION : Lead and manage the Fashion Brand, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room teams to ensure effective collaboration and seamless execution across the entire product development process. Develop seasonal collection strategies and creative concepts based on market trends, consumer insights, and business objectives. Drive trend forecasting, color direction, fabric innovation, silhouette development, and product assortment planning. Oversee the complete product lifecycle from concept, design, sourcing, sample development, approvals, and production handover. Ensure all products meet brand identity, quality standards, target costing, and customer expectations. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Sales, Ecommerce and Marketing to ensure timely product launches. Lead sourcing strategies by identifying suitable suppliers, fabrics, trims, and manufacturing solutions that balance quality, cost, and lead time. Oversee the daily operations of the Sample Room to ensure efficient sample development and sample development calendar by setting priorities based on business needs, seasonal launches, and critical deadlines. Supervise sample development, fitting sessions, garment construction reviews, and product refinements before production Work closely with Pattern Makers, Product Developers, and Designers to resolve technical issues during sample development. Review and approve design specifications, technical packages, BOMs, material selections, trims, artwork, and construction details. Evaluate product performance and market feedback to continuously improve future collections with other departments Establish and continuously improve product development processes, SOPs, and cross-functional workflows. Act as the primary point of contact for customer custom projects, managing communication with customers, aligning project requirements and expectations, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful execution from concept through final delivery. Prepare product presentations, development updates and KPIM reports REQUIREMENT : Minimum 10 years of experience in the fashion or apparel industry, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, preferably across Design, Sourcing & Product Development, and Sample Room functions. Strong knowledge of apparel product development, garment construction, pattern development, fitting, fabrics, trims, sourcing, and manufacturing processes. Solid understanding of product costing, quality standards, vendor management, and supply chain operations. Excellent project management, planning, and organizational abilities with the capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Results-oriented, innovative, detail-focused, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced fashion environment.

jobs.title: Principal / Head of School
jobs.description: 🌿 WE’RE HIRING | Principal/Head of School 📍 Wira’s Playroom — Kemang, Jakarta Selatan “A Safe Space to Grow, A Trusted Place to Thrive.” Wira’s Playroom is an inclusive learning space where children grow with joy, dignity, and acceptance—supported holistically to become confident learners and individuals. We include: Special Needs School, Therapy Center, Early Intervention Program & Kindergarten to Primary 6. About the Role The Principal/Head of School serves as the institutional leader, positioned above the three core organizational pillars. Reporting directly to the Foundation's Board, you will build and maintain the school's strategy, standards, people decisions, financial sustainability, and safeguarding protocols. Rather than managing day-to-day vertical operations, you will lead strategically through three direct reports: the Clinical & Therapy Lead, the Education Lead, and the Operations Lead. Key Responsibilities Vision & Strategy: Own the school’s vision, values, and strategic direction. Set annual performance goals across all three pillars to ensure a unified, cohesive institution. Senior Leadership Rhythm: Supervise, develop, and hold the three pillar leads accountable. Establish and run senior leadership rhythms, meetings, and institutional priorities. Academic & Clinical Oversight: Hold overall accountability for student outcomes, teaching quality, and therapy standards through your specialized leads, ensuring high performance without micromanaging daily delivery. Culture, Induction & Training: Lead whole-school onboarding and institutional training focused on corporate values, culture, conduct, safeguarding, and operational procedures. Stakeholder Management & Escalation: Serve as the primary external face of the school to parents, regulators, and the community. Sit at the apex of the escalation line to handle the most critical institutional issues and determine board-level notifications. Governance, Finance & Safeguarding: Secure child safeguarding protocols, maintain ultimate regulatory/legal compliance, approve budgets, and guide the school's overall financial health and sustainability alongside the Operation Lead. Emergency Operational Support: Provide short-term classroom cover or supervision within your own competence during genuine emergencies to maintain safety and routine. (Does not replace credentialed clinical therapy delivery).

jobs.title: Hard Service Facilities Coordinator (English Speaking)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Coordinate and monitor the daily performance of the Client infrastructure, understand the critical MEP systems including UPS, CRAC, HVAC, Chiller, Generators, Plumbing, Fire Safety Systems, and BMS (Building Management Systems). Supervise onsite technician and external contractors performing engineering, repair, and maintenance tasks. Manage, supervise and develop a close working relationship with third-party engineering contractors, ensuring all Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and reactive tasks are completed to SLA standards. Conduct regular walkthroughs / inspections onsite Client premise to identify potential failures, safety hazards or areas for improvement, and ensure safety standards are complies with local building codes, environmental regulations, and occupational health and safety standards. Act as a central point of contact connecting technical operations with the wider site team and respond swiftly to equipment failures and incidents. Must be prepared to be on call and work out of normal working hours where applicable. Review vendor service reports, diagnose technical issues based on their findings, and recommend cost-effective solutions. Asset Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation for all technical equipment, warranties, service histories, and regulatory certificates. Permit-to-Work (PTW) management: Review and issue risk assessments and work method statements. Supporting stakeholders to any request related to facilities and coordinate special projects as directed by JLL or Client Qualifications & Experience Minimum Diploma in any related field, preferably in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Minimum 3 years in Facilities Management field, experienced or have knowledge in technical operations works. Good communication skills (written and spoken english is mandatory) Ability to build good working relationships with Managers, Stakeholders, Landlords, Colleagues and Service providers.

jobs.title: Staff Marketing
jobs.description: Kami mencari Staff Marketing yang berpengalaman dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Tuju Kuda Hitam Sakti. Tanggung Jawab Menyiapkan dan mengelola dokumen ekspor (PIB, PEB, invoice, packing list, COO, Bill of landing, dll.) Menyiapkan dan menyediakan barang yang dipesan buyer untuk pengiriman ekspor. Berkoordinasi dengan tim/lintas tim, forwader beacukai, shipping line, dan pihak terkait. Mencari buyer luar negeri, bernegosiasi dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan calon buyer / buyer. Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan strategi pemasaran terintegrasi yang mencakup saluran digital dan tradisional untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek. Mengelola kampanye pemasaran multi-channel, termasuk media sosial, email marketing, dan iklan digital, untuk mencapai target audiens yang tepat. Membuat konten pemasaran yang menarik dan relevan, termasuk copy, grafis, dan materi promosi yang selaras dengan pedoman merek perusahaan. Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis kompetitor untuk mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan dan tren industri terkini. Berkolaborasi dengan tim internal, termasuk tim penjualan dan produk, untuk memastikan pesan pemasaran yang konsisten dan efektif. Mengelola anggaran pemasaran dengan efisien dan melacak ROI dari setiap kampanye untuk optimasi berkelanjutan. Menganalisis data pemasaran dan metrik kinerja untuk memberikan laporan reguler dan rekomendasi perbaikan kepada manajemen. Mendukung event pemasaran, peluncuran produk, dan aktivitas promosi lainnya untuk memaksimalkan keterlibatan pelanggan. Persyaratan Gelar Sarjana dalam Pemasaran, Akuntansi, Komunikasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Usia maksimal 35th dan mampu berbahasa inggris. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang pemasaran, komunikasi pemasaran, atau peran marketing yang relevan dan memahami regulasi, alur dan dokumen ekspor impor (PIB, PEB, invoice, packing list, COO, Bill of landing, dll.) Memahami proses kepabeanan, shipping dan prosedur logistic internasional. Terbiasa berkoordinasi dengan buyer, forwader, beacukai, shipping line, dan pihak terkait. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang strategi pemasaran digital, media sosial, saluran pemasaran online, teliti, komunikatif, bertanggung jawab serta mampu berkoordinasi lintas tim. Keahlian dalam menggunakan platform media sosial dan alat analitik pemasaran digital. Kemampuan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris lebih disukai. Keterampilan analitis yang kuat dengan kemampuan menginterpretasikan data dan membuat keputusan berbasis insight. Kreativitas dan kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dalam mengembangkan kampanye inovatif. Kemampuan manajemen proyek dengan perhatian terhadap detail dan mampu mengelola prioritas multitasking. Pengalaman dengan Microsoft Office dan alat desain grafis dasar merupakan nilai tambah.

  • Menganalisis data pemasaran dan metrik kinerja untuk memberikan laporan reguler dan rekomendasi perbaikan kepada manajemen.

  • Mendukung event pemasaran, peluncuran produk, dan aktivitas promosi lainnya untuk memaksimalkan keterlibatan pelanggan.

Persyaratan

  • Gelar Sarjana dalam Pemasaran, Akuntansi, Komunikasi, Bisnis, atau bidang terkait.

  • Usia maksimal 35th dan mampu berbahasa inggris.

  • Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman kerja di bidang pemasaran, komunikasi pemasaran, atau peran marketing yang relevan dan memahami regulasi, alur dan dokumen ekspor impor (PIB, PEB, invoice, packing list, COO, Bill of landing, dll.)

  • Memahami proses kepabeanan, shipping dan prosedur logistic internasional.

  • Terbiasa berkoordinasi dengan buyer, forwader, beacukai, shipping line, dan pihak terkait.

  • Pemahaman yang kuat tentang strategi pemasaran digital, media sosial, saluran pemasaran online, teliti, komunikatif, bertanggung jawab serta mampu berkoordinasi lintas tim.

  • Keahlian dalam menggunakan platform media sosial dan alat analitik pemasaran digital.

  • Kemampuan komunikasi verbal dan tertulis yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris lebih disukai.

  • Keterampilan analitis yang kuat dengan kemampuan menginterpretasikan data dan membuat keputusan berbasis insight.

  • Kreativitas dan kemampuan problem-solving yang baik dalam mengembangkan kampanye inovatif.

  • Kemampuan manajemen proyek dengan perhatian terhadap detail dan mampu mengelola prioritas multitasking.

  • Pengalaman dengan Microsoft Office dan alat desain grafis dasar merupakan nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Rough Mill Supervisor
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT Good Wood Interior mencari seorang Rough Mill Supervisor yang berpengalaman dan kompeten untuk memimpin operasional Sawmill, Kiln Dry, Pembahanan kami di Kabupaten Jepara, Jawa Tengah. Sebagai Rough Mill Supervisor, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam memastikan efisiensi pembahanan, kualitas hasil kerja, dan keselamatan kerja di departemen rough mill. Posisi ini memerlukan kepemimpinan yang kuat, pemahaman mendalam tentang proses pengolahan kayu, dan kemampuan untuk mengelola tim yang dinamis. Ini adalah posisi kontrak yang menawarkan tanggung jawab signifikan dalam operasi manufaktur interior kayu berkualitas tinggi. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengawasi dan mengelola tim rough mill dalam melaksanakan aktivitas produksi harian, termasuk pengolahan kayu baku, pemotongan, dan persiapan material untuk tahap produksi berikutnya. Memastikan semua proses produksi berjalan sesuai dengan standar kualitas perusahaan, spesifikasi teknis, dan timeline yang telah ditetapkan. Menerapkan dan mengawasi protokol keselamatan kerja yang ketat untuk meminimalkan risiko kecelakaan dan memastikan lingkungan kerja yang aman bagi seluruh anggota tim. Memonitor dan mengoptimalkan penggunaan mesin dan kayu, serta memastikan pemeliharaan rutin dilakukan tepat waktu. Mengelola inventory material baku dan memastikan ketersediaan papan yang cukup untuk kelancaran produksi. Melatih, membimbing, dan mengembangkan anggota tim untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan produktivitas mereka. Melaporkan progress produksi, mengidentifikasi hambatan, dan memberikan solusi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional. Melakukan inspeksi berkala terhadap hasil kerja dan memastikan perbaikan berkelanjutan dalam kualitas dan output produksi. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain seperti Quality Control, PPIC, dan Maintenance untuk memastikan sinkronisasi operasional yang baik. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Minimal 5 tahun pengalaman sebagai supervisor atau pemimpin tim di industri manufaktur, khususnya di bidang pengolahan kayu atau rough mill. Pemahaman mendalam tentang proses pengolahan kayu, spesifikasi material, mesin produksi, dan teknik quality control. Kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan pengalaman mengelola tim 10-20 orang atau lebih. Pengetahuan tentang standar keselamatan kerja dan regulasi industri manufaktur, dengan track record implementasi program K3 yang baik. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia. Keterampilan problem-solving dan pengambilan keputusan yang cepat dan tepat dalam situasi operasional yang kompleks. Pengetahuan tentang lean manufacturing atau continuous improvement principles adalah nilai tambah yang signifikan. Kemampuan menggunakan sistem informasi dan software produksi untuk monitoring dan pelaporan. Sertifikasi atau training di bidang manajemen produksi, keselamatan kerja, atau kepemimpinan adalah preferensi. Berpikiran analitis dengan perhatian terhadap detail dalam mengelola standar kualitas dan target produksi. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kinerja. Tunjangan kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja yang komprehensif. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung inovasi dan perbaikan berkelanjutan. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan teknologi dan peralatan produksi modern di industri manufaktur interior kayu. Tim yang solid dan profesional dengan budaya kerja yang kolaboratif. Jaminan sosial dan tunjangan karyawan sesuai dengan peraturan perburuhan yang berlaku. Tentang PT Good Wood Interior PT Good Wood Interior adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri manufaktur furniture yang berbasis di Kabupaten Jepara, Jawa Tengah—pusat industri mebel Indonesia yang terkenal secara internasional. Dengan dedikasi terhadap keunggulan dalam craftsmanship, desain inovatif, dan kualitas material, kami menghasilkan produk interior kayu berkualitas premium yang dipasarkan ke pasar nasional dan internasional. Perusahaan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan profesional karyawan dan menerapkan standar keselamatan kerja tertinggi. Kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan kami bergantung pada keahlian, dedikasi, dan inovasi tim kami. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan menuju keunggulan operasional di industri mebel Indonesia. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman relevan dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim PT Good Wood Interior sebagai Rough Mill Supervisor, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV, surat motivasi, dan portfolio pengalaman Anda melalui portal aplikasi kami. Kami menantikan untuk bertemu dengan Anda dan membahas bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan kami.

jobs.title: Resources Geologist
jobs.description: Job responsibilities: Geological Modelling & Resource Evaluation: Manage geological databases and maintain data integrity. Develop geological models and block models. Prepare mineral resource estimations in accordance with recognised industry standards. Support resource classification and reserve conversion processes. Review drilling results and recommend additional exploration programmes. Technical Support: Provide geological and mine planning support to mining operations. Conduct ore control and grade reconciliation. Analyze deviations between mine plans and actual production. Recommend corrective actions to improve operational performance. Technical Due Diligence: Evaluate mining projects from both technical and economic perspectives. Support feasibility studies, project development, and investment analysis. Conduct technical due diligence for mining acquisitions and new project opportunities. Supervise field data collection including mapping, testpit, drilling and sampling activities. Reporting & Governance Ensure compliance of Good Mining Practice, and applicable regulations. Monitor departmental budgets and resource utilization. Lead continuous improvement initiatives within the Technical Services function. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Geology/Geological Engineering Minimum 5 years of experience in the exploration and evaluation of laterite nickel resources and reserves. Cross-commodity experience, such as coal and gold, is a plus. Experience managing mining operations and open-pit mine planning. Proficiency in mapping and resource and reserve estimation software (ArcGIS, Surpac, Leapfrog). Proficiency in scheduling software such as Vulcan and Minesched is a plus. Having a Class A driver's license (SIM A)

jobs.title: Operation Training Manager (Project Based)
jobs.description: Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end development and implementation of the company's operational training framework. Design competency-based learning programs, training roadmaps, and certification pathways for operational employees. Develop and standardize training materials, SOPs, operational manuals, job aids, and learning resources. Collaborate with Operations, HR, QA, and other stakeholders to identify capability gaps and training requirements. Design onboarding programs for new operational employees and leadership development programs for supervisors and managers. Establish competency assessment methods, certification processes, and evaluation tools. Develop Train-the-Trainer (TTT) programs to build internal training capabilities. Coordinate pilot training sessions, gather feedback, and continuously improve learning content and delivery methods. Work with IT or external vendors to support the implementation of Learning Management Systems (LMS) or digital learning platforms where applicable. Define training KPIs, reporting dashboards, and effectiveness measurement methodologies. Ensure project milestones, timelines, budgets, and deliverables are achieved. Prepare documentation and conduct knowledge transfer to the permanent operations or learning team upon project completion. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Education, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Training & Development, Learning & Development, or Operations Training, with at least 2 years leading projects or managing training initiatives. Proven experience in developing training systems, competency frameworks, and operational learning programs. Experience in retail, F&B, hospitality, or multi-site operations is highly preferred. Strong instructional design, facilitation, coaching, and curriculum development skills. Familiarity with competency mapping, certification programs, SOP development, and adult learning principles. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders. Strong project management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) is an advantage. Willing to travel to operational sites as required. Available to work on a project-based contract.

jobs.title: Driver
jobs.description: Tugas & Tanggung Jawab : Mengantar dan menjemput atasan (direksi/manajemen) sesuai jadwal dan kebutuhan operasional. Mengantar dan menjemput karyawan yang melakukan perjalanan dinas atau keperluan operasional perusahaan. Mengemudikan kendaraan perusahaan dengan aman, nyaman dan tepat waktu. Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan dan kondisi kendaraan operasional. Melakukan pengecekan rutin kendaraan (BBM, oli, ban, air radiator dan kondisi mesin). Mengurus keperluan operasional perusahaan, seperti pengiriman atau pengambilan dokumen dan kebutuhan adminsitrasi. Memastikan seluruh perjalanan dilakukan dengan mematuhi peraturan lalu lintas serta menjaga kerahasiaan informasi perusahaan dan atasan. Kualifikasi : Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK sederajat. Memiliki SIM A aktif. Pengalaman sebagai Driver Direksi / Driver Operasional minimal 2 tahun. Memahami rute JABODETABEK. Berpenampilan rapi, sopan, jujur, disiplin dan bertanggung jawab. Memiliki etika kerja yang baik serta mampu menjaga kerahasiaan dan profesionalisme. Tidak memiliki catatan kriminal. Bersedia bekerja lembur atau di luar jam kerja apabila diperlukan. Berdomisili di Jakarta Utara.

jobs.title: Tax Supervisor
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities : 1. Tax Compliance & Reporting Prepare, review, and submit monthly and annual tax returns (SPT Masa & Tahunan) in compliance with Indonesian tax regulations. Handle various types of taxes, including: PPh 21, PPh 23, PPh 4(2), PPh 26 PPh 25 Value Added Tax (PPN) Ensure timely submission of tax reports to avoid penalties and sanctions. Maintain accurate and well-organized tax documentation. 2. Tax Reconciliation Perform regular reconciliation between accounting records and tax reports. Identify and resolve discrepancies between commercial and fiscal data. Prepare fiscal adjustments and supporting schedules. 3. Tax Payment & Monitoring Calculate tax liabilities accurately and ensure timely tax payments. Monitor tax payment schedules and compliance with deadlines. Maintain proper records of tax payments and official receipts (SSP / e-billing). 4. Vendor Tax Verification Review vendor invoices to ensure correct tax treatment (PPN and withholding taxes). Ensure proper withholding and remittance of vendor-related taxes. Review vendor tax documentation, including: Tax Invoices (Faktur Pajak) NPWP validity Coordinate with Procurement and Accounts Payable teams regarding vendor tax compliance. 5. Tax Audit & Correspondence Prepare data and documents required for tax audits or inquiries from tax authorities. Act as liaison with tax consultants and the tax office (DJP). Follow up on tax assessments, objections, or appeals as required. 6. Regulatory Update & Tax Risk Management Monitor updates to Indonesian tax regulations and assess business impact. Provide recommendations to management on tax compliance and efficiency. Identify potential tax risks and propose mitigation strategies. 7. Parent Company Transactions Prepare journal entries related to parent company transactions. Prepare financial statements for the parent company. Coordinate with external auditors during the parent company audit process. Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance. Minimum 4–6 years of experience in taxation, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role preferred. Strong knowledge of Indonesian tax regulations and reporting systems (Coretax). Certified in Tax Brevet A & B. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software. Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail, and ability to work under tight deadlines. Good communication and leadership abilities.

Key Responsibilities :

1. Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Prepare, review, and submit monthly and annual tax returns (SPT Masa & Tahunan) in compliance with Indonesian tax regulations.

  • Handle various types of taxes, including:

    • PPh 21, PPh 23, PPh 4(2), PPh 26

    • PPh 25

    • Value Added Tax (PPN)

  • Ensure timely submission of tax reports to avoid penalties and sanctions.

  • Maintain accurate and well-organized tax documentation.

2. Tax Reconciliation

  • Perform regular reconciliation between accounting records and tax reports.

  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between commercial and fiscal data.

  • Prepare fiscal adjustments and supporting schedules.

3. Tax Payment & Monitoring

  • Calculate tax liabilities accurately and ensure timely tax payments.

  • Monitor tax payment schedules and compliance with deadlines.

  • Maintain proper records of tax payments and official receipts (SSP / e-billing).

4. Vendor Tax Verification

  • Review vendor invoices to ensure correct tax treatment (PPN and withholding taxes).

  • Ensure proper withholding and remittance of vendor-related taxes.

  • Review vendor tax documentation, including:

    • Tax Invoices (Faktur Pajak)

    • NPWP validity

  • Coordinate with Procurement and Accounts Payable teams regarding vendor tax compliance.

5. Tax Audit & Correspondence

  • Prepare data and documents required for tax audits or inquiries from tax authorities.

  • Act as liaison with tax consultants and the tax office (DJP).

  • Follow up on tax assessments, objections, or appeals as required.

6. Regulatory Update & Tax Risk Management

  • Monitor updates to Indonesian tax regulations and assess business impact.

  • Provide recommendations to management on tax compliance and efficiency.

  • Identify potential tax risks and propose mitigation strategies.

7. Parent Company Transactions

  • Prepare journal entries related to parent company transactions.

  • Prepare financial statements for the parent company.

  • Coordinate with external auditors during the parent company audit process.

Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance.

  • Minimum 4–6 years of experience in taxation, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of Indonesian tax regulations and reporting systems (Coretax).

  • Certified in Tax Brevet A & B.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.

  • Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail, and ability to work under tight deadlines.

  • Good communication and leadership abilities.

Requirements: Minimum bachelor’s degree in management, economics, or any related degree. Have an understanding of the current market and submarket conditions. Ability to plan and negotiate and the knowledge of the market. Able to run reports set by management. Leadership ability. Ability to work in a stressful environment. jobs.title: Staf Akunting
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. Golden Rock Group membuka kesempatan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami sebagai Staf Akunting di lokasi North Jakarta, Jakarta. Posisi ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam bidang akuntansi keuangan dengan fokus pada pelaporan keuangan yang akurat dan tepat waktu. Sebagai Staf Akunting, Anda akan menjadi bagian integral dari tim keuangan yang bertanggung jawab atas pencatatan, verifikasi, dan pelaporan transaksi keuangan perusahaan. Posisi ini adalah pekerjaan penuh waktu yang memerlukan kehadiran di kantor kami di North Jakarta, Jakarta. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan harian secara akurat dan sistematis secara manual maupun sistem akuntansi. Memverifikasi dan mengkonfirmasi dokumen-dokumen keuangan seperti invoice, faktur, bukti pembayaran, dan kwitansi. Menyelaraskan akun-akun dan melakukan rekonsiliasi bank secara berkala untuk memastikan keakuratan data keuangan. Membantu dalam penyiapan laporan keuangan bulanan, triwulanan, dan tahunan sesuai dengan standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Memelihara dan mengorganisir dokumen keuangan dengan baik untuk keperluan audit dan kepatuhan pajak. Melakukan posting jurnal dan penyesuaian akun untuk memastikan akurasi pencatatan transaksi. Mendukung tim akunting dalam berbagai tugas administratif dan operasional terkait keuangan. Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan kelengkapan dan keakuratan data keuangan yang dibutuhkan. Melakukan perhitungan dan pelaporan pajak bulanan dan tahunan (PPN, PPh dan SPT Tahunan). Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Sarjana dalam Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait dari institusi yang terakreditasi. Menguasai System DJP dan Coretax. Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman dalam bidang akuntansi keuangan atau pelaporan keuangan. Pemahaman yang kuat tentang standar akuntansi keuangan dan prinsip-prinsip akuntansi dasar. Mahir dalam menggunakan software akuntansi seperti Accurate, SAP, atau sistem akuntansi lainnya yang relevan. Keterampilan analisis yang baik dengan perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dan akurasi. Kemampuan untuk mengelola multiple tugas dan bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat. Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik dan kemampuan untuk berkolaborasi secara efektif dengan tim. Pengetahuan tentang regulasi perpajakan dan kepatuhan keuangan di Indonesia merupakan keuntungan. Integritas tinggi dan komitmen terhadap kerahasiaan data keuangan perusahaan. Lamar sekarang untuk menjadi bagian dari tim akunting kami dan berkontribusi pada kesuksesan PT. Golden Rock Group. Kami menunggu aplikasi Anda yang lengkap dengan CV dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk mengembangkan karir Anda di bidang akuntansi keuangan yang dinamis dan profesional.

jobs.title: Sales Merchandiser - Batam
jobs.description: Ringkasan Peran Bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan ketersediaan dan penataan produk perusahaan secara optimal di toko-toko (outlet) yang ditunjuk, serta menjalin hubungan baik dengan pihak toko untuk meningkatkan penjualan. Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Penataan Produk (Merchandising): Menata produk di rak ( display ) agar mudah terlihat dan menarik perhatian pembeli, sesuai dengan standar yang ditetapkan perusahaan. Pengawasan Stok: Memantau ketersediaan produk di toko. Menginformasikan dan mendorong pihak toko untuk melakukan pemesanan ulang jika stok menipis. Pemasangan Materi Promosi: Memasang materi promosi (poster, stiker, flyer , dll.) di titik-titik strategis di dalam toko. Hubungan Pelanggan: Menjalin dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan pemilik toko atau staf, serta mengatasi keluhan yang ada. Pelaporan: Membuat laporan harian atau mingguan tentang kondisi stok, aktivitas kompetisi, dan hasil penataan produk. Kualifikasi Pendidikan: Minimal lulusan SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Pengalaman: Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman sebagai Sales Merchandiser atau Sales di industri FMCG. Keterampilan: Kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri dan berorientasi pada target. Memiliki pemahaman tentang strategi merchandising dan tata letak produk. Persyaratan Teknis: Memiliki kendaraan motor pribadi dan SIMC yang berlaku. Menguasai area yang akan ditugaskan. Cover area Batam. Domisili Batam.

jobs.title: Procurement & Contracts Executive
jobs.description: About the role PT. Tembesi Development Partners is seeking a talented and experienced Procurement & Contracts Executive to join our team in Batam, Riau Islands. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in our manufacturing. As a Procurement & Contracts Executive, you will be responsible for managing our procurement processes, negotiating supplier contracts, and ensuring optimal value delivery for the organisation. This role requires an individual who can operate strategically whilst managing day-to-day procurement activities, and represents a key position within our supply chain management function. Key responsibilities Identify, evaluate and select suppliers and vendors that meet our quality, cost and delivery requirements Develop and negotiate commercial terms with suppliers to secure competitive pricing and favourable contract conditions Draft, review and execute procurement contracts and purchase agreements in accordance with company policies and legal requirements Manage the full procurement cycle from requisition through to receipt and invoice processing Maintain accurate inventory records and monitor stock levels to ensure efficient supply chain operations Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders across the organisation Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement process improvements within the procurement function Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, regulations and industry standards Prepare procurement reports, analyses and recommendations for management review Liaise with operations, finance and other departments to understand procurement needs and priorities What we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Economics or a related field Minimum 3-5 years of procurement and/or contracts management experience within manufacturing, transportation or logistics sectors Proven track record of successfully managing supplier negotiations and contract administration Strong knowledge of procurement best practices, supply chain principles and inventory management Proficiency in using procurement systems and Microsoft Office applications Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Indonesian Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail Knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements in Indonesia is advantageous Experience with cost analysis, vendor performance management and process optimisation is preferred What we offer PT. Tembesi Development Partners is committed to providing a supportive and professional working environment where our employees can thrive. We offer a competitive salary package commensurate with experience, opportunities for professional development and skills enhancement, and a collaborative workplace culture that values innovation and excellence. We provide health and safety benefits, and foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed and respected. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our operations whilst developing your career within a growing and dynamic organisation. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and welcome discussions regarding any reasonable accommodations or support you may require during the recruitment process. About us PT. Tembesi Development Partners is a forward-thinking organisation operating in the manufacturing, transportation and logistics sectors. We are committed to delivering quality services and products whilst maintaining the highest standards of operational excellence and professional integrity. Our mission is to build sustainable supply chain solutions that create value for our clients, partners and stakeholders. With a focus on innovation, efficiency and continuous improvement, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner in the region. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, our commitment to employee development, and our dedication to fostering long-term relationships with our suppliers and customers. Apply now If you are a motivated and experienced procurement professional looking for your next opportunity, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter and any relevant certificates or qualifications to our recruitment team. We look forward to hearing from you.

PT. Tembesi Development Partners is seeking a talented and experienced Procurement & Contracts Executive to join our team in Batam, Riau Islands. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in our manufacturing. As a Procurement & Contracts Executive, you will be responsible for managing our procurement processes, negotiating supplier contracts, and ensuring optimal value delivery for the organisation. This role requires an individual who can operate strategically whilst managing day-to-day procurement activities, and represents a key position within our supply chain management function.

Key responsibilities

  • Identify, evaluate and select suppliers and vendors that meet our quality, cost and delivery requirements

  • Develop and negotiate commercial terms with suppliers to secure competitive pricing and favourable contract conditions

  • Draft, review and execute procurement contracts and purchase agreements in accordance with company policies and legal requirements

  • Manage the full procurement cycle from requisition through to receipt and invoice processing

  • Maintain accurate inventory records and monitor stock levels to ensure efficient supply chain operations

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders across the organisation

  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement process improvements within the procurement function

  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, regulations and industry standards

  • Prepare procurement reports, analyses and recommendations for management review

  • Liaise with operations, finance and other departments to understand procurement needs and priorities


What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Economics or a related field

  • Minimum 3-5 years of procurement and/or contracts management experience within manufacturing, transportation or logistics sectors

  • Proven track record of successfully managing supplier negotiations and contract administration

  • Strong knowledge of procurement best practices, supply chain principles and inventory management

  • Proficiency in using procurement systems and Microsoft Office applications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Indonesian

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements in Indonesia is advantageous

  • Experience with cost analysis, vendor performance management and process optimisation is preferred


What we offer

PT. Tembesi Development Partners is committed to providing a supportive and professional working environment where our employees can thrive. We offer a competitive salary package commensurate with experience, opportunities for professional development and skills enhancement, and a collaborative workplace culture that values innovation and excellence. We provide health and safety benefits, and foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed and respected. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to our operations whilst developing your career within a growing and dynamic organisation.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and welcome discussions regarding any reasonable accommodations or support you may require during the recruitment process.

About us

PT. Tembesi Development Partners is a forward-thinking organisation operating in the manufacturing, transportation and logistics sectors. We are committed to delivering quality services and products whilst maintaining the highest standards of operational excellence and professional integrity. Our mission is to build sustainable supply chain solutions that create value for our clients, partners and stakeholders. With a focus on innovation, efficiency and continuous improvement, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner in the region. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, our commitment to employee development, and our dedication to fostering long-term relationships with our suppliers and customers.

Apply now

If you are a motivated and experienced procurement professional looking for your next opportunity, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter and any relevant certificates or qualifications to our recruitment team. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: admin keuangan & Perpajakan
jobs.description: Kesempatan CV Asia Afrika Dental mencari seorang Admin Keuangan & Perpajakan yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Admin Keuangan & Perpajakan, Anda akan bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola keuangan dan perpajakan perusahaan dengan efisien dan akurat. Kandidat ideal memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang regulasi perpajakan Indonesia, keterampilan administrasi yang kuat, dan kemampuan untuk mengelola berbagai aspek keuangan perusahaan dengan presisi tinggi. Posisi ini merupakan pekerjaan penuh waktu yang berbasis di Bandung, Jawa Barat, dan menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam bidang akuntansi dan perpajakan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola pembukuan dan pencatatan transaksi keuangan secara sistematis dan terorganisir sesuai dengan sistem perusahaan. Menyiapkan dan memproses laporan keuangan bulanan, triwulanan, dan tahunan dengan akurat dan tepat waktu. Menangani aspek perpajakan perusahaan termasuk perhitungan pajak, pelaporan SPT, dan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi perpajakan Indonesia. Memverifikasi dan merekonsiliasi rekening bank, akun piutang, dan hutang untuk memastikan keakuratan data keuangan. Mengelola administrasi keuangan sehari-hari, termasuk pemrosesan faktur, pembayaran vendor, dan pengeluaran operasional. Membantu Oprasional bagian Administrasi dan keuangan Memastikan semua catatan keuangan dan dokumen perpajakan tersimpan dengan aman dan terorganisir dengan baik. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimum Diploma atau Sarjana dalam bidang Akuntansi, Perpajakan, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman dalam administrasi keuangan dan perpajakan di perusahaan atau firma akuntansi. Pemahaman tentang perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk PPh, PPN, dan pelaporan SPT. Kemampuan menggunakan Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Access) dengan tingkat lanjut untuk analisis dan laporan keuangan. Keahlian dalam rekonsiliasi bank, pemrosesan faktur, dan manajemen akun. Kemampuan komunikasi yang efektif dan kolaboratif dalam bekerja dengan berbagai departemen. Integritas tinggi dan komitmen terhadap kerahasiaan informasi keuangan perusahaan. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV Anda beserta surat lamaran yang menunjukkan pengalaman dan keterampilan Anda dalam administrasi keuangan dan perpajakan. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik!

jobs.title: Territory Sales Supervisor
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Mengelola dan mengawasi kinerja tim sales di wilayah yang menjadi tanggung jawab. Mencapai target penjualan yang telah ditetapkan, baik dari segi volume, nilai, maupun distribusi. Menyusun rencana kunjungan harian ( route plan ) serta merancang strategi penjualan wilayah yang efektif. Memantau dan mengevaluasi performa sales secara berkala (harian, mingguan, dan bulanan). Membina dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan pelanggan, pemilik toko, serta distributor. Menangani keluhan pelanggan serta menyelesaikan kendala operasional yang terjadi di lapangan. Melakukan pemantauan stok secara rutin guna memastikan ketersediaan produk di pasar. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan hasil penjualan secara akurat kepada Sales Manager atau Area Manager. Melatih, mengarahkan, dan mengembangkan kemampuan teknis maupun non-teknis tim sales. Memastikan implementasi program promosi berjalan sesuai standar dan tepat sasaran di lapangan. Persyaratan Pekerjaan Berpengalaman sebagai Sales Supervisor dengan rekam jejak kepemimpinan dan manajemen tim yang kuat. Mahir dalam teknik negosiasi, komunikasi persuasif, serta mampu membina hubungan baik dengan mitra. Memiliki kemampuan analisis data penjualan dan strategi pasar untuk mencapai target yang ditetapkan. Proaktif dalam pemecahan masalah (problem solving) dan memiliki manajemen waktu yang efektif. Menguasai wilayah penjualan yang menjadi tanggung jawab serta mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel. Wajib memiliki SIM C dan/atau SIM A aktif untuk mendukung mobilitas tinggi di lapangan.

jobs.title: Vehicle Operation Specialist (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description: Job Description: 1. Route and Cost Data Analysis Conduct route planning analysis and continuously improve transportation data. Perform transportation lane efficiency analysis and cost accrual management. 2. Expense Management Manage various transportation-related expenses, including fuel and toll cost, and ensure timely expense reconciliation and settlement. Be responsible for vehicle settlement and transportation expense reconciliation. 3. Contract and HR Data Management Prepare and execute temporary transportation contracts in a timely and accurate manner. Generate driver attendance and payroll-related data to ensure the accuracy and consistency of attendance records. 4. Supplier and System Management Monitor the timeliness of temporary vehicle deployment and coordinate with the Quality Control (QC) department and suppliers. Maintaining the accuracy of system records and operational ledgers. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field. jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Superintendent
jobs.description: About the role As the Sales & Marketing Superintendent at one of our subsidiaries , you will support the Company's business expansion by developing new corporate customers, maintaining existing client relationships, and assisting in the execution of sales initiatives. You will play an important role in promoting the Company's B2B vehicle leasing solutions while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This full-time position is based in South Jakarta, Jakarta . What you'll be doing Identify and develop new business opportunities within the corporate market. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to maximize business opportunities. Conduct customer visits, presentations, and business meetings to promote the Company's leasing services. Prepare quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for prospective customers. Coordinate the contract process and ensure timely completion of required documentation. Monitor sales pipeline and update customer relationship management records. Conduct market research to identify industry trends and competitor activities. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure excellent customer experience throughout the leasing process. Prepare regular sales reports and business development updates. Support marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and promotional activities. What we're looking for Proficiency in English (oral and written) is a must. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management. Experience in vehicle leasing, fleet management, automotive, transportation & logistics, equipment leasing, or related B2B service industries is highly preferred. Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills. Good understanding of sales processes and business development activities. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Highly motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently. Strong interpersonal and presentation skills. Willingness to travel for customer visits and business development activities. What we offer At PT Samindo Resources Tbk', we are committed to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment that enables our employees to thrive. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Our focus on work-life balance ensures that our employees can maintain a healthy lifestyle and achieve their personal goals. If you are an experienced Sales & Marketing Superintendent looking to take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply now and join our growing team.

As the Sales & Marketing Superintendent at one of our subsidiaries, you will support the Company's business expansion by developing new corporate customers, maintaining existing client relationships, and assisting in the execution of sales initiatives. You will play an important role in promoting the Company's B2B vehicle leasing solutions while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This full-time position is based in South Jakarta, Jakarta.

What you'll be doing

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within the corporate market.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to maximize business opportunities.

  • Conduct customer visits, presentations, and business meetings to promote the Company's leasing services.

  • Monitor sales pipeline and update customer relationship management records.

  • Conduct market research to identify industry trends and competitor activities.

  • Collaborate with internal departments to ensure excellent customer experience throughout the leasing process.

  • Prepare regular sales reports and business development updates.

  • Support marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and promotional activities.

What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in English (oral and written) is a must.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management.

  • Experience in vehicle leasing, fleet management, automotive, transportation & logistics, equipment leasing, or related B2B service industries is highly preferred.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.

  • Good understanding of sales processes and business development activities.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Highly motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently.

  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

  • Willingness to travel for customer visits and business development activities.

What we offer
At PT Samindo Resources Tbk', we are committed to fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment that enables our employees to thrive. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Our focus on work-life balance ensures that our employees can maintain a healthy lifestyle and achieve their personal goals.

If you are an experienced Sales & Marketing Superintendent looking to take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply now and join our growing team.

jobs.title: Accounting Staff
jobs.description: Persyaratan Umum: Maximal Umur 35Tahun Kualifikasi: Gelar Sarjana dengan latar belakang Akuntansi. Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di posisi serupa. Memiliki pengalaman dalam sistem Accurate Mampu mengoprasikan komputer dengan sistem Operasi Windows & Aplikasi Microsoft Office dengan Baik. Memiliki pengalaman dengan Proses Akuntansi Umum. Familiar dengan sistem E-Faktur. Memiliki pengalaman dengan Auditor (Internal/Eksternal) merupakan hal tambah. Kemampuan Analitis yang kuat, integritas, & kemampuan untuk memenuhi tenggat waktu keuangan yang ketat Tanggung Jawab & Tugas: Meninjau dan memverifikasi kelengkapan, keakuratan, dan viliditas dan semua dokumen pendukung keuangan sebelum memproses pembayaran. Melakukan entri jurnal yang akurat untuk transaksi akun harian sesuai dengan praktik akuntansi dasar. Menyiapkan Rekonsiliasi bank tepat waktu, memelihara buku bank yang rapi, dan memantau arus kas harian. Menyiapkan draf laporan keuangan (penyusutan, amortisasi, akural) Membangun dan memelihara sistem pengarsipan fisik dan digital yang terorganisir dan aman untuk semua dokumen keuangan dan akuntansi.

jobs.title: HC STRATEGIC & INSIGHT
jobs.description: A. Job Purpose (Ringkasan Pekerjaan) Posisi HC Strategic & Insight berperan sebagai "otak analitis" di dalam divisi Human Capital. Peran utama posisi ini adalah mengubah raw data sumber daya manusia menjadi actionable insights (wawasan yang dapat dieksekusi) untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis tingkat eksekutif. Posisi ini menjembatani gap antara inisiatif pengelolaan SDM dengan target bisnis Graha Trans & Group, memastikan setiap program HC berdampak langsung pada efisiensi operasional, produktivitas, dan profitabilitas perusahaan. B. Key Responsibilities (Tanggung Jawab Utama) 1. People Analytics & Dashboard Management Merancang, membangun, dan mengelola executive dashboard (menggunakan Power BI, Tableau, atau Data Studio) yang melacak metrik HC&GA secara real-time (misal: Headcount , Turnover Rate per Site , Recruitment Cost , dan Training ROI ). Mengelola dan memastikan integritas data (data integrity) HC&GA secara menyeluruh, serta melakukan validasi berkala guna menjamin keakuratan dan keandalan informasi sebelum diolah dan disajikan kepada manajemen. Menyediakan pelaporan data dan presentasi HC&GA yang akurat dan on-time untuk kebutuhan rapat direksi (BOD Meeting). Memimpin pelaksanaan Employee Opinion Survey (EOS) secara berkala, melakukan analisis mendalam terhadap sentimen dan tingkat keterikatan ( engagement ) karyawan, serta merumuskan rekomendasi perbaikan ( action plan ) yang strategis bagi manajemen. 2. Strategic Alignment & Performance Evaluation Menganalisis efektivitas dan dampak finansial dari program-program HC&GA. Melakukan Project Tracker dari HC&GA yang sedang berjalan untuk memastikan timeline dan tujuan tercapai sesuai yang telah ditentukan oleh Direksi Menyelaraskan KPI dari divisi Human Capital dengan Strategic Objective perusahaan. 3. Market Intelligence & Benchmarking Melakukan riset dan analisis tren pasar ketenagakerjaan, khususnya di industri logistik, transportasi, dan supply chain . Berkolaborasi dengan Compensation & Benefits team untuk Membandingkan ( benchmarking ) skema kompensasi, benefit , dan strategi retensi Graha Trans dengan kompetitor untuk memastikan perusahaan tetap kompetitif dalam menarik talenta unggul. 4. Predictive Analytics & Risk Mitigation Membangun sistem early warning berbasis data untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah HC&GA sebelum berdampak pada business Menyusun rekomendasi Corrective Action & Preventive Action berbasis akar masalah ( Root Cause Analysis ) dari data Employee Opinion Survey (EOS) atau Exit Interview . 5. Strategic Advisory Berperan sebagai penasihat strategis ( strategic advisor ) bagi HC Director dan manajemen puncak dengan memberikan rekomendasi kebijakan HC&GA yang objektif dan berbasis fakta ( data-driven decision making ). C. Kualifikasi & Kompetensi (Requirements) 1. Latar Belakang & Pengalaman Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Statistika, Matematika, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Industri, Teknik Informatika, Manajemen Bisnis, atau disiplin ilmu terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang HR Analytics , Strategic HR , Business Intelligence , atau Management Consulting . Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai lanskap bisnis operasional/logistik menjadi nilai tambah yang sangat besar. 2. Hard Skills (Technical) Mahir ( Advanced ) dalam mengolah data menggunakan Microsoft Excel (Macros, Power Query, Pivot tingkat lanjut) dan SQL. Menguasai tools visualisasi data seperti Power BI, Tableau, atau Google Data Studio, Microsoft office, Canva, dsb. Memiliki literasi finansial yang baik; mampu membaca laporan laba/rugi (P&L) untuk menghubungkan b1aya manpower ( personnel cost ) & General Affairs (Asset Cost) dengan efisiensi budget perusahaan. 3. Soft Skills Business Acumen: Memiliki ketajaman bisnis untuk mengaitkan metrik HR dengan tujuan bisnis secara keseluruhan. Analytical Thinking: Kemampuan memecahkan masalah yang kompleks dan menyajikan cerita di balik angka ( data storytelling ). Agility & Communication: Mampu bekerja dalam ritme yang cepat ( fast-paced ), komunikatif, dan mampu mempresentasikan data teknis menjadi bahasa bisnis yang mudah dipahami oleh manajemen.

This role is essential to the success of our airline operations and directly impacts our ability to deliver exceptional service to our passengers. Key responsibilities Oversee daily airline operations including flight scheduling, crew management, and aircraft maintenance coordination Manage operational performance metrics and key performance indicators to ensure targets are consistently met Coordinate with various departments including flight operations, ground services, and customer service to ensure seamless operations Implement and relationships Report on operational performance to senior management and provide strategic recommendations What we're looking for Minimum 10 years of experience in ground handling companies Proven developing high-performing teams Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities Proficiency in airline operational systems and management software Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration or a related field is preferred Knowledge of Indonesian aviation About the role

PT Apex Nusantara Indo is seeking an experienced Senior Operations Manager to join our Clients team in Aviation. This is a full-time position that plays a critical role in overseeing and optimising our airline operations. As Senior Operations Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth, efficient and safe flight operations whilst maintaining the highest standards of service delivery. This role is essential to the success of our airline operations and directly impacts our ability to deliver exceptional service to our passengers.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee daily airline operations including flight scheduling, crew management, and aircraft maintenance coordination

  • Manage operational performance metrics and key performance indicators to ensure targets are consistently met

  • Coordinate with various departments including flight operations, ground services, and customer service to ensure seamless operations

  • Implement and maintain operational procedures and safety protocols in compliance with industry regulations and standards

  • Resolve operational issues and disruptions promptly to minimise delays and passenger impact

  • Lead, mentor and supervise operational staff and team leaders to foster a culture of excellence and accountability

  • Monitor and manage operational budgets and resource allocation to optimise efficiency

  • Conduct regular audits and reviews of operational processes to identify areas for improvement

  • Liaise with airport authorities, regulatory bodies and partner airlines to maintain positive working relationships

  • Report on operational performance to senior management and provide strategic recommendations

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in ground handling companies

  • Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale flight operations and complex operational challenges

  • Strong knowledge of airline operations, including flight scheduling, crew management, aircraft maintenance and ground handling procedures

  • Excellent understanding of aviation regulations, safety standards and compliance requirements

  • Demonstrated leadership ability with experience managing and developing high-performing teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities

  • Proficiency in airline operational systems and management software

  • Bachelor's degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration or a related field is preferred

  • Knowledge of Indonesian aviation regulations and familiarity with Jakarta airport operations is advantageous

Apply now

If you are an experienced operations professional with a passion for airline management and a proven track record of operational success, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and any supporting documentation to our recruitment team. Join PT Apex Nusantara Indo and be part of a dynamic organisation shaping the future of aviation in Indonesia.

jobs.title: TRANSLATOR BAHASA MANDARIN
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Translator Bahasa Mandarin yang berpengalaman dan berdedikasi untuk bergabung dengan tim PT. Hoki Metal Indonesia. Sebagai Translator Bahasa Mandarin, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memfasilitasi komunikasi yang efektif antara tim internal, mitra bisnis, dan klien internasional kami. Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan penerjemahan yang akurat dan profesional dalam kedua bahasa, serta pemahaman mendalam tentang konteks budaya dan terminologi industri. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi tetap penuh waktu yang berbasis di Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten, dengan tanggung jawab untuk mendukung operasional administrasi dan dokumentasi perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menerjemahkan dokumen bisnis, kontrak, proposal, dan komunikasi lainnya dari Bahasa Mandarin ke Bahasa Indonesia dan sebaliknya dengan akurasi tinggi. Melakukan interpretasi dalam rapat, negosiasi, dan diskusi bisnis antara tim internal dan mitra atau klien berbahasa Mandarin. Memastikan konsistensi terminologi dan gaya penerjemahan di semua dokumen perusahaan dan materi komunikasi. Mengelola dan mengorganisir dokumen terjemahan, memelihara file arsip yang terstruktur dengan baik untuk referensi di masa depan. Berkolaborasi dengan departemen lain untuk memahami kebutuhan penerjemahan spesifik dan memberikan dukungan administrasi yang diperlukan. Melakukan pengecekan kualitas pada terjemahan untuk memastikan tidak ada kesalahan dan sesuai dengan standar profesional. Mendukung kegiatan administrasi perkantoran lainnya yang berkaitan dengan komunikasi internasional dan dokumentasi perusahaan. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Menguasai Bahasa Mandarin secara aktif dan pasif (lisan dan tulisan) dengan tingkat keahlian profesional. Memiliki kemampuan berbahasa Indonesia yang sempurna, baik lisan maupun tulisan. Minimal 3-5 tahun pengalaman bekerja sebagai penerjemah atau dalam peran yang melibatkan penerjemahan profesional. Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat tentang budaya China dan Indonesia untuk memastikan penerjemahan yang akurat dan kontekstual. Berpengalaman dalam menangani dokumen teknis atau bisnis, khususnya di industri manufaktur atau logam. Memiliki sertifikasi penerjemah atau pendidikan formal di bidang penerjemahan, bahasa, atau komunikasi internasional adalah keuntungan. Kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik dan dapat menangani berbagai tugas secara bersamaan dengan deadline yang ketat. Perhatian terhadap detail dan komitmen terhadap akurasi dalam setiap pekerjaan penerjemahan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dan dapat bekerja secara efektif dalam tim multikultural. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda. Paket asuransi kesehatan komprehensif untuk Anda dan keluarga. Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional berkelanjutan dalam bidang penerjemahan dan administrasi. Lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, kolaboratif, dan mendukung pertumbuhan profesional. Program kesejahteraan karyawan termasuk asuransi jiwa. Keseimbangan kehidupan kerja dengan jam kerja yang teratur dan cuti tahunan yang memadai. Tentang Perusahaan PT. Hoki Metal Indonesia adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri manufaktur logam yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan produk berkualitas tinggi dan layanan terbaik kepada klien di seluruh dunia. Dengan jaringan internasional yang luas dan mitra bisnis dari berbagai negara, termasuk China, kami terus berinovasi dan mengembangkan solusi bisnis yang efektif. Perusahaan kami menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai integritas, profesionalisme, dan kerja sama tim dalam menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan produktif. PT. Hoki Metal Indonesia percaya bahwa komunikasi yang efektif adalah kunci kesuksesan bisnis global, dan kami berkomitmen untuk mempekerjakan talenta terbaik yang dapat mendukung visi kami untuk menjadi pemimpin industri di tingkat internasional. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kualifikasi di atas dan tertarik dengan kesempatan ini, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami di PT. Hoki Metal Indonesia dan jadilah bagian dari perusahaan yang menghargai profesionalisme, keunggulan, dan kolaborasi internasional. Kirimkan CV, portofolio penerjemahan (jika ada), dan surat motivasi Anda kepada tim Sumber Daya Manusia kami hari ini.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Head – Banking Cards & Smart Cards
jobs.description: Export Sales Manager (Smart Cards / Metal Cards) Key Responsibilities Develop and execute business plans and sales strategies for Smart Cards and Metal Cards across assigned international markets. Achieve revenue, DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), and sales targets. Identify and develop new export business opportunities by analyzing market trends, customer needs, competitor activities, and regulatory requirements. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline with clear revenue generation opportunities. Identify prospective customers through market research, business networks, trade fairs, and other lead generation activities. Ensure compliance with country-specific regulations, commercial terms, payment terms, and delivery requirements. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless business execution: Pricing/Costing Team – Obtain competitive pricing for customer inquiries. Operations Team – Ensure timely order fulfillment and compliance with quality standards. Finance & Accounts Team – Support documentation, invoicing, and billing processes. Collections Team – Monitor receivables and follow up on outstanding payments. Implement effective sales and distribution strategies to meet customer requirements and business objectives. Conduct market research to identify new opportunities and expand market presence. Provide market intelligence and competitor analysis to support strategic business decisions. Maintain CRM data and manage both internal and external business communications. Support brand positioning and enhance the company's presence in international markets. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or Business Administration (MBA). Minimum 8 years of experience in the Security Printing, Banking Cards, Smart Cards, or Payment Cards industry . Proven experience in international/export sales and business development. Strong understanding of global markets, customer acquisition, and export regulations. Experience managing sales pipelines and achieving revenue targets. Required Skills Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Strong negotiation and relationship management skills. Effective planning, organizational, and time management abilities. Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret market trends and competitive landscapes.

jobs.title: Bisnis Operasional Staff
jobs.description: Tentang Posisi Kami mencari Staff Bisini sOperasional yang memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik, teliti, serta mampu mengelola operasional perusahaan secara administratif. Posisi ini akan berperan penting dalam mendukung operasional HR dan memastikan seluruh aktivitas operasional online e-commerce berjalan dengan lancar. Tanggung Jawab Administrasi HR Mengelola dan memperbarui database karyawan. Mengelola absensi karyawan dan memastikan data kehadiran akurat. Mengadministrasikan dokumen dan data personalia. Membantu administrasi operasional yang berkaitan dengan kebutuhan HR. Operasional Online E-COMMERCE Memastikan ketersediaan stok produk pada seluruh platform penjualan online. Melakukan maintenance data produk, stok, dan kebutuhan operasional marketplace. Mengelola kebutuhan operasional seperti ATK, material packing (dus, bubble wrap, dll.), dan perlengkapan penunjang operasional lainnya. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Customer Service, Warehouse, dan Purchasing untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional. Membantu meningkatkan efisiensi proses operasional melalui perbaikan administrasi dan sistem kerja. Kualifikasi Pria/Wanita, usia minimal 27 tahun . Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Teknik Industri, Sistem Informasi, atau jurusan lain yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 5 tahun sebagai Operational E-Commerce Specialist. RAJIN, TEKUN dan CEKATAN. Berpengalaman mengelola operasional marketplace/e-commerce seperti maintenance stok, data produk, serta kebutuhan operasional online. Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Office , terutama Microsoft Excel (Pivot Table, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, IF, SUMIFS, dan pengolahan data). Terbiasa bekerja menggunakan sistem OMS . Memiliki kemampuan analisis, administrasi, dan problem solving yang baik. Teliti, disiplin, memiliki inisiatif tinggi, serta mampu bekerja secara multitasking dengan target dan deadline. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan berbagai departemen. Berintegritas tinggi, mampu menjaga kerahasiaan data perusahaan dan data karyawan. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Bersedia ditempatkan di Depok, Jawa Barat .

jobs.description: Senior Graphic Designer for Biosoop Biosoop is a growing vegan baby skincare brand committed to providing safe, gentle, and effective products for sensitive baby skin. We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to support our marketing initiatives and elevate our visual brand presence across all channels. Key Responsibilities : Develop and produce high-quality visual assets for digital platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, e-commerce, and marketing campaigns Translate Biosoop’s brand identity (vegan, gentle, safe, and modern) into consistent and compelling visual executions Design promotional materials such as campaign banners, product visuals, educational content, and digital ads Ensure consistency of brand guidelines across all visual outputs (static and motion) .Collaborate with marketing, social media, and content teams to deliver cohesive and effective campaigns Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, including product launches and weekly content calendars Requirements : Minimum 1 years of experience in graphic design, preferably within skincare, baby care, FMCG, or lifestyle brands Strong portfolio demonstrating clean, modern, and emotionally engaging design work Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator Experience handling high-volume content production and campaign rollouts Up-to-date with design trends, particularly in baby care, parenting, and wellness industries Strong attention to detail, with a good sense of visual hierarchy and brand consistency

jobs.title: RTM Specialist
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented RTM Specialist to support our Indonesia vape channel operations. This is an ASR (Agency Staff) role, ideal for a candidate with 1–3 years of FMCG or channel operations experience, strong Excel and data capabilities, and high compliance awareness. You will be the backbone of trade expense verification, channel data tracking, inventory/sample coordination, and after-sales administration. Key Responsibilities - Expense Verification: Manage monthly trade expense claims and Lark (Feishu) approval workflows. Strictly audit execution photos and sales proofs to prevent fraud and ensure full compliance. - Data Tracking: Maintain the channel distribution database. Track sub-distributors’ Sell-in/Sell-out (SI/SO), yearly agreement progress, and new-product distribution rates. - Inventory & Samples: Coordinate replacement programs for old Cukai / slow-moving products, including inventory tracking, scheme design, subsidy calculation, and physical recall. Manage office and new-product samples. - After-Sales Management: Process after-sales expense claims and defective product recalls. Summarize frontline quality feedback to drive internal product improvements. What You’ll Need - Bachelor’s degree or above (full-time, from a recognized university). - 1–3 years of work experience; FMCG, vape, consumer electronics, or trade-marketing/RTM background preferred. - Proficient in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data cleaning) and data analysis; strong business acumen for channel distribution logic and core metrics (SI/SO). - Meticulous and highly principled; able to identify forged proofs and abnormal data with sharp risk-control awareness. - Strong independent execution and cross-functional coordination skills, especially for large-scale product replacements/recalls. - Excellent problem-solving ability and service mindset; able to align internal departments to resolve frontline issues. - Fluent English (listening, speaking, reading, writing) as the working language. - Strong mathematical/logical reasoning (test score ≥ 13 preferred). - DISC-C type preferred: analytical, process-driven, detail-obsessed, and comfortable with repetitive compliance work.

- Expense Verification: Manage monthly trade expense claims and Lark (Feishu) approval workflows. Strictly audit execution photos and sales proofs to prevent fraud and ensure full compliance.

- Data Tracking: Maintain the channel distribution database. Track sub-distributors’ Sell-in/Sell-out (SI/SO), yearly agreement progress, and new-product distribution rates.

- Inventory & Samples: Coordinate replacement programs for old Cukai / slow-moving products, including inventory tracking, scheme design, subsidy calculation, and physical recall. Manage office and new-product samples.

- After-Sales Management: Process after-sales expense claims and defective product recalls. Summarize frontline quality feedback to drive internal product improvements.

What You’ll Need

- Bachelor’s degree or above (full-time, from a recognized university).

- 1–3 years of work experience; FMCG, vape, consumer electronics, or trade-marketing/RTM background preferred.

- Proficient in Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data cleaning) and data analysis; strong business acumen for channel distribution logic and core metrics (SI/SO).

- Meticulous and highly principled; able to identify forged proofs and abnormal data with sharp risk-control awareness.

- Strong independent execution and cross-functional coordination skills, especially for large-scale product replacements/recalls.

- Excellent problem-solving ability and service mindset; able to align internal departments to resolve frontline issues.

- Fluent English (listening, speaking, reading, writing) as the working language.

- Strong mathematical/logical reasoning (test score ≥ 13 preferred).

- DISC-C type preferred: analytical, process-driven, detail-obsessed, and comfortable with repetitive compliance work.

jobs.title: Account Receivable Staff
jobs.description: Kami membuka kesempatan bagi profesional yang teliti dan berorientasi pada detail untuk bergabung sebagai AR Staff . Posisi ini bertanggung jawab mengelola piutang usaha, memastikan proses penagihan berjalan tepat waktu, melakukan rekonsiliasi pembayaran pelanggan, serta mendukung kelancaran arus kas perusahaan. Anda akan bekerja sama dengan tim Finance, Sales, dan operasional untuk memastikan seluruh transaksi penjualan tercatat secara akurat dan sesuai prosedur. Memantau jatuh tempo piutang serta melakukan follow up penagihan secara berkala. Melakukan pencatatan dan rekonsiliasi pembayaran pelanggan. Menyusun laporan umur piutang (Aging Report) dan laporan penerimaan kas. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Sales, Finance, dan pelanggan terkait penyelesaian selisih pembayaran. Memastikan seluruh transaksi terdokumentasi dengan baik dan sesuai SOP perusahaan. Mendukung proses audit internal maupun eksternal. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai AR Staff atau Finance Staff. Memahami proses Accounts Receivable, penagihan, rekonsiliasi, dan administrasi keuangan. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel serta software akuntansi/ERP. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, komunikasi, dan negosiasi yang baik. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, serta mampu bekerja dengan target. Bersedia ditempatkan di Sidomulyo, Lampung Selatan

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.description: PERSONAL ASSISTANT TO CEO Key Responsibilities: Manage the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, business trips, and personal errands. Coordinate calendars, reminders, and priorities to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Accompany the CEO to meetings, events, business trips, and brand activations when required. Drive the CEO or support transportation needs when necessary. Assist with content preparation, including filming behind-the-scenes, social media content, and campaign documentation. Help create simple moodboards, storyboards, and content ideas based on campaign or brand requirements. Capture with proper angles and compositions during shoots or events. Support light video editing and content preparation using CapCut or similar editing tools. Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. Assist with ad-hoc business and personal tasks to ensure the CEO can focus on strategic priorities. Requirements: Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or similar role is preferred. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask efficiently. Strong communication and time management skills. Comfortable handling both professional and personal assistance. Able to work flexible hours, including evenings or weekends when required. Comfortable accompanying the CEO to meetings, shoots, events, or business trips. Familiar with social media platforms and current content trends. Basic editing skills (CapCut or equivalent). Able to create simple moodboards or storyboards is a plus. Trustworthy, discreet, proactive, and able to work independently. Must have an active SIM A and be confident driving.
